name: permark
description: Read what your AI writes. Write what it reads. A free, open-source Markdown app.
author: Edelmar Schneider

scripts.fmt: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/shell-ext/Cargo.toml && prettier --write .
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/shell-ext/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/shell-ext/Cargo.toml && vitest run
scripts.check: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/shell-ext/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/shell-ext/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/shell-ext/Cargo.toml && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && vitest run
